Name: Ram, Son of Jerahmeel
Summary: Firstborn son of Jerahmeel and father of Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:25: Firstborn son of Jerahmeel and father of Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Ram stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
